sloka: तस्य वानरशार्दूल चतस्रो मूर्ध्निसम्भवाः।द्रक्ष्यस्योषधयो दीप्ता दीपयन्त्यो दिशो दश ।। ६.७४.३२ ।।
transliteration: tasya vānaraśārdūla catasro mūrdhnisambhavāḥ।drakṣyasyoṣadhayo dīptā dīpayantyo diśo daśa ।। 6.74.32 ।।

translations.english: "O Tiger among monkeys! You will see on the summit four medicinal herbs growing there illuminating the ten directions."
